items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the correction law, in relation to requiring religious dietary
food options in prison commissaries and visitor's areas
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4748

SPONSOR: RAMOS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the correction law, in relation to requiring religious
dietary food options in prison commissaries and visitor's areas

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill allows for kosher food products to be made available to
inmates who require these standards for their religious observance with-
in the New York State prison systems.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one of this bill amends the correction law adding section 134.
The commissary at all correctional facility in New York State shall make
available food for purchase to inmates who require them due to dietary
requirements which include but are not limited to Kosher and Halal
products requiring a higher standard for religious observance.  These
dietary standards should be made available at any correctional facility
that is housing any inmate requiring these standards even if that number
is one. These dietary requirements should be made available for purchase
within vending machines in the visiting areas of New York State
correction facilities.

Section two of this bill sets forth the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Currently, some New York State Correctional facilities vending machines
and commissary do not adhere to the dietary restrictions for those
following strict religious observances. It is imperative that food be
available for purchase through commissary and vending machines for all,
including those with these varying restrictions.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None, as these items are purchased.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect sixty days after it shall have become law.

summary: Requires commissaries at correctional facilities to provide food options for purchase through the commissary that satisfy the requirements of halal, kosher and other religious dietary needs of the incarcerated individuals housed at the facility; requires correctional facilities to provide food options for purchase from vending machines located in the visitor's area of the facility that satisfy the requirements of halal, kosher and other religious dietary needs of the incarcerated individuals housed at the facility; and requires that the cost of such food options be comparable to food options that are ordinarily available.
title: Requires religious dietary food options in prison commissaries and visitor's areas
